title: Prompting a person to approve or deny a deferred tool call
description: When a run pauses with DeferredToolRequests, this script asks the user for approval and resumes the run with their decision.

steps.description: Create the Deps instance and UsageLimits(request_limit=6, tool_calls_limit=4), then start the run with agent.run_sync.
If result.output is a DeferredToolRequests object, loop over its pending approvals and prompt the user with [y/N].
Record True or ToolDenied for each tool_call_id, resume agent.run_sync with the saved message_history and deferred_tool_results, and print the final output and trace.
